rule: A caller-supplied run id (fabric.wire.run(run_id)) is emitted as 'r-' + the first 32 lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(key, run_id) when FABRIC_WIRE_ID_KEY is set and non-empty (key = its UTF-8 bytes, at least 16; capture refuses a shorter key), else of SHA-256(run_id); run_id is UTF-8 encoded. key null = unset. Generated fallback ids (trace:<32hex>, source:<source_id>:<epoch>) are emitted unchanged; a caller value that merely looks like one is still pseudonymised. fabric.reconstruct --run applies the same function to the clear id. Decision J1: the same 32 hex (same key, same input) names the other operator labels, only the prefix differs: capture emits fabric.source_id as 's-' + hex of the source id and the private provider's service.name as 'svc-' + hex of its name unless FABRIC_WIRE_LABELS=clear; the reconstruction report shows tenant ids as 't-' + hex and projects any clear (legacy) source id to its 's-' form. So for every case, 's-'/'svc-'/'t-' + pseudonym[2:] is the source, service and tenant pseudonym of run_id.

cases.name: unkeyed, looks like a trace fallback
